en: Vintage black‑and‑white printed postcard showing a town market square. On the left stands an ornate town hall with a decorative gabled façade and a clock tower; on the right side of the square is a tall church with a pointed spire. Other multi‑storey townhouses line the square. The caption in red Gothic/Latin script at the top identifies the scene as the market with the town hall and church in Geringswalde.
